tide-tab.scope: Top-level element roots with render_slot in layout-before-render.json. Nested content belongs to its owning root; foundation furniture has no grid render_slot and is outside this pairwise test.
tide-tab.threshold: At least 1px overlap on both rendered axes, with at least one original axis separated or touching. Existing positive overlap on both original axes is recorded separately and never labelled new.
